overview: Opclo is a local shop discovery app that lets customers instantly see which nearby shops are open or closed today — saving time and unnecessary trips. Shop owners can register their store, manage hours, and toggle their open/closed status in real time. Features include shop categories, star ratings, photo galleries, live location, favorites, global search, and 5-minute pre-close owner notifications.
features: Browse shops by category (street food, juice shop, bakery, etc.)
Real-time open/closed status for every shop
Shop detail page with photos, address, map, and Instagram link
Owner registration with live location picker
Owner dashboard with manual open/close toggle
